datasets.dataset_name: IMD High-Resolution Daily & Automatic Weather Station (AWS) Rainfall
datasets.provider: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
datasets.spatial_resolution: 0.25° (~27 km) regional / AWS localized station points (downscaled to 350m)
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Historical rainfall time-series for multi-city model training; AWS 15-min telemetry for real-time nowcasting

datasets.dataset_name: Climate Hazards Center InfraRed Precipitation with Station Data (CHIRPS)
datasets.provider: Climate Hazards Center, University of California Santa Barbara (UCSB) / USGS
datasets.usage_in_ufns: High-resolution satellite-gauge blended rainfall for antecedent precipitation index (API: 1h, 3h, 6h, 24h). Strict policy: v3 only, v2 blocked.

datasets.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / Airbus Defence and Space
datasets.version: GLO-30 Public 2024 Edition (Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem)
datasets.license: Open Access (Copernicus Full, Free and Open Licence)
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Topographic baseline AMSL, slope gradient, D8 flow directions, flow accumulation, and depression trough extraction for all 10 cities

datasets.dataset_name: Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Ground Range Detected (GRD)
datasets.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / European Commission Copernicus Programme
datasets.version: Level-1 GRD Interferometric Wide (IW) Mode Dual-Pol (VV+VH) 2024 Cycle
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Ground truth flood extent and water presence masks for historical supervised training and validation. Otsu thresholding + Lee speckle filtering.

datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL 1.0)
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Multi-modal road graphs, building density, emergency facilities (hospitals, fire, police), and waterways

datasets.dataset_name: ESA WorldCover Global Land Cover Product
datasets.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / VITO Remote Sensing
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Urban impervious surface fractions, soil infiltration coefficients, and surface Manning roughness values

datasets.provider: Municipal Corporations: BBMP (Bengaluru), Delhi Jal Board / PWD (Delhi), MCGM (Mumbai)
datasets.temporal_coverage: Static Master Plan Infrastructure + Real-Time Telemetry
datasets.spatial_resolution: Centimeter-accurate pipe diameters, inverts, and outfall coordinates
datasets.license: Government Administrative Restricted / Public Infrastructure Audit Access
datasets.usage_in_ufns: Subterranean conduit diameters, inlet capacities, slope gradients, and surcharge calculation. Unmetered conduits explicitly tagged as DRAINAGE DATA: UNAVAILABLE / SIMULATED.
